text:
PagerBot: ALERT: GPU pool eu-prod-1 queue depth > 1500, throttle=85%, autoscaler failing to add nodes. paging oncall (rota: Alice)
Alice: on it. seeing large tail of queued inference jobs and high enqueue latency in ingress. any config rollouts recently?
Marco: we pushed a batching config change in infra yesterday — reduced continuous batching window to 10ms (was 50ms) and changed prefix_cache.ttl from 30s -> 5s as part of a perf experiment.
Leah: that TTL change would cause prefix cache misses and reduce KV reuse — could increase per-token work.
Alice: confirmed prefix cache hit-rate dropped from ~78% to 23% in eu-prod-1 since ~09:12 UTC. batching effective batch size also dropped 4x.
Raj: autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts but failing due to per-az caps. requests for new instances are getting 409s from cloud provider.
Ivy: customer-facing SLO dashboards show 30m window with p95 latency up 2.3s and errors for streaming sessions. marking impacted: high.
CS-Eli: notified top 3 enterprise customers (Acme, BrightCo, NovaApps) that we're investigating. they reported degraded throughput and partial failures.
Alice: immediate plan: 1) temp scale override (force max pool size) 2) revert batching/prefix config commit 3) route a small % to eu-prod-2 region 4) keep customers updated.
Marco: I can revert the config — commit id abc123 contains the batching/prefix changes.
SRE-Bot: INCIDENT created INC-2026-3860012345, severity:P1, oncall: Alice. paging escalation scheduled in 3m.
Alice: Marco — please revert then I'll trigger a manual scale and shift traffic. Marco: reverting now.
Marco: running:
```
cd infra/serving-configs
git revert --no-edit abc123
git push origin main
./deploy-configs --env eu-prod --service serving
```
Marco: revert pushed at 09:28 UTC.
Leah: verifying config diff — batch-window-ms restored to 50ms, prefix_cache.ttl back to 30s.
Alice: manual scale override to bypass autoscaler limits:
```
# temporarily bump pool size
rcli pool update eu-prod-1 --gpu-pool-size 60 --force-override
```
Alice: scale request accepted by control plane; provider still returning quota 409s for new instances in az-a — control plane placed instances across other azs where possible.
Raj: autoscaler is failing because regional soft-limit hit; I've opened expedited quota increase with cloud support (case #CS-9987). ETA unknown.
Ivy: routing change: shifting 12% of traffic to eu-prod-2 as a safety. doing gradual ramp.
CS-Eli: sending interim status to customers: "We identified a recent config change causing reduced batching and aggressive prefix cache TTLs; we reverted the change and are performing mitigation. We expect recovery within 30-45 minutes. Will follow up with root cause and postmortem."
Alice: after revert, prefix cache hit-rate climbing back to 69% at 09:40 UTC, effective batch size recovering. queue depth falling from 1600 -> 420.
Marco: cpu/gpu util lowered and per-token latency dropping. looks like commit reverted solved the workload inefficiency.
Leah: note — the change also had unintended interaction with continuous KV prefetch that increased eviction churn. we'll add a guard to config validation to prevent TTL < 15s for prefix_cache.
Raj: cloud support replied: can temporarily raise quota by 10 nodes in region in ~20m. once they apply, autoscaler can resume normal operations.
Ivy: traffic ramp to eu-prod-2 completed; no errors observed.
Alice: marking customer impact: 3 enterprise customers saw throughput degradation and a handful of streaming errors; CS updated. no data exfiltration, no billing changes.
SRE-Bot: post-incident checklist: capture heap+kvstats snapshot, collect autoscaler traces, tag faulty commit abc123, open postmortem doc.
Alice: assigning postmortem owners: Marco (config change), Raj (autoscaler/resilience), Leah (serving runtime), Ivy (routing/fallback).
CS-Eli: scheduling customer follow-up calls with Acme + BrightCo tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
Marco: root cause summary draft: small batching window + low prefix cache TTL -> smaller batches + cache misses -> increased per-request GPU work -> queue growth -> regional capacity limits hit -> autoscaler retries fail due to provider quota -> sustained throttling.
Leah: mitigation actions to prevent recurrence: autoscaler should detect sustained queue growth and escalate to org-level paging if provider 4xx persists; config validator to block extreme batching/prefix combos; add preflight perf test before config rollout.
Alice: closing immediate mitigations: queue stable, p95 latency trending to SLO, manual override will be removed after autoscaler catches up. leaving incident open for postmortem.
CS-Eli: final note to customers will include ETA of full investigation and rollback timeline.
SRE-Bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-3860012345 updated: status=mitigated, severity downgraded to P2 for postmortem.
Alice: thanks team. follow-ups in #incidents-postmortem.
